title: SwitchControl 1.0.6 — Performance & Stability
headline: Dashboard CPU usage is dramatically lower. The AI Advisor now reads your real hardware specs. Tweaks that don't apply to your system are clearly labeled.
changes: Reduced app CPU usage by up to 80% — telemetry now runs one task at a time instead of all at once
Added low-end mode: automatically slows down background tasks on 4-core CPUs or when system load is high
App now skips background data collection entirely when it's already using too much CPU itself
AI Advisor now always reads your actual RAM, CPU, and GPU — fixed cases where it would guess wrong specs
Fixed AI Advisor reporting incorrect memory (e.g. '4 GB') when your real RAM is 16 GB or higher
Tweaks that don't work on your hardware now show a clear reason instead of silently failing
USB power management tweak now checks whether your system actually supports the setting before showing it
Fixed startup white flash on app launch — window is now always dark before content appears
Added per-task timing data to the performance diagnostics panel for easier debugging
